english.title: Cause unnecessary suffering to a protected animal
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused unnecessary suffering to a protected animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..), by

(A)_[an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..),]_
(B)_[a failure to act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 4(1) and 32(1) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 2 of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that a "Protected animal" is one of a kind which is commonly domesticated in the British Islands, is under the control of man whether on a permanent or temporary basis, or it is not living in a wild state.
(ii) See section 33 for deprivation orders.
(iii) See section 34 for disqualification from owning keeping animals.
(iv) See section 35 for power to seize animals in connection with disqualification.
(v) See section 37 for destruction in the interests of the animal.
(vi) See section 40 for the forfeiture of equipment used.
(vii) The maximum penalty for this offence has increased from 29th June 2021; for offences before that date see H8880/AW06001.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Note
Section 32(4A) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that in relation to an offence committed before the commencement of paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 2 to the Sentencing Act 2020, the reference to 12 months is to be read as a reference to 6 months.
